# netbox_custom_link (Data Source)

A custom link rendered on the pages of the object types it applies to (extras.customlink).

From the [official documentation](https://netboxlabs.com/docs/netbox/models/extras/customlink/):

> Users can add custom links to object views in NetBox to reference external resources. For example, you might create a custom link for devices pointing to a monitoring system. See the [custom links documentation](https://netboxlabs.com/docs/netbox/customization/custom-links/) for more information.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_custom_link" "test" {
  name = "test-custom_link"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the link is rendered.
- `id` (Number) NetBox id.
- `name` (String)
- `name_contains` (String) Case-insensitive substring of the name.
- `owner_id` (Number) Id of the owner the object is assigned to.

### Read-Only

- `button_class` (String) Button style. One of: default, blue, indigo, purple, pink, red, orange, yellow, green, teal, cyan, gray, black, white, ghost-dark.
- `created` (String)
- `group_name` (String) Links with the same group name are rendered as a dropdown.
- `last_updated` (String)
- `link_text` (String) Jinja2 template for the link text; the object is available as {{ object }}.
- `link_url` (String) Jinja2 template for the link URL; the object is available as {{ object }}.
- `new_window` (Boolean) Open the link in a new browser window.
- `object_types` (Set of String) Object types the link is shown on, as app-labelled content types (dcim.device).
- `url` (String)
- `weight` (Number) Order within the group.
